prompt.text:
Implement an in-memory work queue as one TypeScript source file.

Export `WorkItem` with readonly `id`, `title`, and `dueLabel` fields, and export class `WorkQueue` with `add(title: string, dueLabel: string): WorkItem`, `complete(id: number): boolean`, and `list(): WorkItem[]`.

A new queue is empty and assigns IDs starting at 1 in increasing order. `add` must trim both strings and throw `TypeError` if either result is empty. It must throw `RangeError` instead of assigning an ID beyond `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`. `complete` must throw `TypeError` for a non-safe-integer ID; otherwise it removes the matching item and returns `true`, or returns `false` when absent. Remaining order must not change. `list` and `add` must return copies, and no returned object or array may alias internal mutable state. Failed operations must leave the queue unchanged. Use no external packages.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
